{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows negative bias (e.g., -0.25 or 0.00 with recent lows).",
    "Reduce forecast volatility after consecutive negative sentiment entries; model tends to overreact.",
    "When true outcome exceeds forecast by >5% in 3 consecutive days, apply mean reversion correction by 1-2% per day.",
    "If forecast spikes >10% above recent 15-day average, reduce by 20-30% of the spike magnitude.",
    "For sentiment history with increasing positivity (e.g., 0.00 → 0.33 → 0.50), model tends to overestimate; apply 5-10% downward bias.",
    "After a forecast dip below 65.00, avoid sharp upward corrections unless sentiment confirms bullish shift (e.g., >0.50).",
    "If true outcome is consistently 5-10% below forecast over 3+ days, apply a 5% downward bias to next forecast.",
    "For sentiment history with 0.00 for 3+ days, model tends to overestimate; apply 3-5% downward correction."
  ]
}
